data.name: Entra_Broker_Desc
data.value: Off (recommended): Vitrine signs in in its own window that remembers nothing – security key (FIDO2), passkey, password or Authenticator, any account, also on the lock screen. On: Windows Hello for Business and device-based Conditional Access, but the broker remembers accounts and signs in with the account of the Windows session – only for devices with one personal user.

data.name: Entra_Fresh_Desc
data.value: Without this option an existing Microsoft session could unlock without any input.

data.name: Entra_MaxAge_Desc
data.value: Checks auth_time if Microsoft provides it. 0 = no check.

data.name: Entra_Redirect_Desc
data.value: Enter it in the app registration under “Mobile and desktop applications”.

data.name: Entra_Step1
data.value: 1. In the Entra admin center, create an app registration (“Vitrine”, this directory only).

data.name: Entra_Step2
data.value: 2. Add the platform “Mobile and desktop applications”, enter the redirect URI below, enable “Allow public client flows”.

data.name: Entra_Step3
data.value: 3. Enter the application ID and directory ID here. Optionally create the app roles “Vitrine.Admin” / “Vitrine.Unlock”.

data.name: Entra_Tenants_Desc
data.value: Only needed with “organizations” or several tenants. One tenant ID per line.

data.name: Entra_TestAdminYes
data.value: yes (app role Vitrine.Admin or Global Administrator)

data.name: Entra_Test_Desc
data.value: Signs you in with the current (also unsaved) values and shows what Vitrine sees.

data.name: Int_Plugins_Desc

data.name: Int_Scripts_Desc
data.value: Commands run invisibly through cmd.exe. Variables: %VITRINE_EVENT%, %VITRINE_TRIGGER%, %VITRINE_USER%, %VITRINE_METHOD%, %VITRINE_CODE%, %VITRINE_TIME%.

data.name: Lock_Autostart_Desc
data.value: Vitrine starts in the notification area after sign-in. Set per user.

data.name: Lock_BlockMouse_Desc
data.value: Off: the pointer may move (e.g. to point at something); clicks stay blocked.

data.name: Lock_HotkeyNeedsModifier
data.value: Please use Ctrl, Alt or Win

data.name: Lock_Hotkey_Desc
data.value: Click into the field and press the combination you want. Del clears it.

data.name: Lock_Idle_Desc
data.value: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input. 0 = off.

data.name: Lock_KeepAwake_Desc
data.value: Prevents the screen saver and sleep while locked.

data.name: Lock_OnStartup_Desc
data.value: For control rooms and measurement PCs that are only watched after start-up.

data.name: Lock_ReplaceWinL_Desc
data.value: Instead of the Windows lock screen, also when unlocked. While Vitrine runs, Lock is hidden on the Ctrl + Alt + Del screen.

data.name: Lock_Schedule_Desc
data.value: Lock at fixed times. One entry per line: 18:00 or 07:30@{0}

data.name: Look_Blank_Desc
data.value: The screen is covered – for confidential data. Programs keep running.

data.name: Look_Language_Desc
data.value: Default for this device. Each user can choose their own language in the About window, unless a policy sets it.

data.name: Look_Logo_Desc
data.value: PNG or JPG, shown above the name.

data.name: Look_Message_Desc
data.value: Shown in the bar at the bottom, e.g. “Measurement running – please do not touch”.

data.name: Look_Preview_Desc
data.value: Locks for a moment – unlock as usual.

data.name: Look_Transparent_Desc
data.value: Programs stay visible – ideal for watching measurements and processes.

data.name: Prompt_ExternalEntra
data.value: The Microsoft sign-in opens in a separate window. Security key, passkey, password or Authenticator – depending on your company policy. Nothing is remembered.

data.name: Prompt_ExternalHello
data.value: Face, fingerprint or Windows Hello PIN. Only for the person signed in to this workstation.

data.name: Prompt_Footer
data.value: Sign-ins are recorded in the audit log.

data.name: Prompt_SignFooter
data.value: Your signature is recorded with name, time and meaning.

data.name: Sec_Action
data.value: Action after too many failed attempts

data.name: Sec_AuthUi_Desc
data.value: Only these processes receive input while the Microsoft or Hello window is open.

data.name: Sec_Delay_Desc
data.value: From the 3rd failed attempt the waiting time grows: 2 s, 4 s, 8 s … up to 30 s.

data.name: Sec_MaxFailed_Desc
data.value: Then the chosen action takes effect. 0 = unlimited.

data.name: Sec_Sas_Desc
data.value: Hides Task Manager, Sign out, Change a password and Lock there while locked; Win + L does nothing.

data.name: Sec_UserConfig_Desc
data.value: Allows %LocalAppData%\Vitrine\config.json in addition to the device configuration.

data.name: Sec_Watchdog_Desc
data.value: If Vitrine is ended or crashes while locked, Windows locks immediately.

data.name: Tray_HotkeyHint
data.value: {0} locks the screen and keeps it visible.

data.name: Tray_RunningText
data.value: {0} locks the screen and keeps it visible.

data.name: Unlock_Allowed_Desc
data.value: Multiple choice. Anyone who meets one of the conditions may unlock.

data.name: Unlock_Domains_Desc
data.value: Optional. One per line, e.g. CONTOSO or contoso.com. Empty = no restriction.

data.name: Unlock_Entra_Desc
data.value: Work account with MFA, Authenticator, passkey, Windows Hello for Business and Conditional Access.

data.name: Unlock_Groups_Desc
data.value: One per line: DOMAIN\group, local group, SID, Entra group ID or app role (e.g. Vitrine.Unlock).

data.name: Unlock_Hello_Desc
data.value: Face, fingerprint or PIN – only for the signed-in person.

data.name: Unlock_Pin_Desc
data.value: Shared password without a link to a person. Not recommended in GxP environments.

data.name: Unlock_Timeout_Desc
data.value: Seconds without input – then everything is locked again.

data.name: Unlock_Users_Desc
data.value: One per line: DOMAIN\name, name@contoso.com or SID.

data.name: Unlock_Windows_Desc
data.value: Local account, Active Directory or Entra account on an Entra-joined device.

data.name: Look_Windows_Desc
data.value: Everything is covered except the windows of the programs listed below. They stay visible even when moved.

data.name: Look_Reveal_Desc
data.value: For “Only selected programs”: one program file per line, e.g. Chromeleon.exe. Windows lying on top of them stay covered.

data.name: Look_Masks_Desc
data.value: Areas that stay covered while the screen is locked, e.g. a field with patient data. One line per area: monitor:x,y,width,height in percent (* = every monitor).

data.name: MaskEditor_Hint
data.value: Drag to cover an area. Right-click an area to remove it.

data.name: Entra_AuthContext_Desc
data.value: Requested at every sign-in, e.g. c1. With a Conditional Access policy for it, Microsoft Entra ID can require a passkey or FIDO2 key. Empty = none.

data.name: Entra_SignAuthContext_Desc
data.value: Only for electronic signatures, e.g. c2 for phishing-resistant sign-in. Empty = as above.

data.name: Entra_ShareIdToken_Desc
data.value: Applications that request a sign-in or signature through the local interface receive the ID token and can verify it with Microsoft themselves. Never written to the audit log.

data.name: Entra_TokenScopes_Desc
data.value: Permissions (scopes) for which applications may request an access token through the local interface, one per line, e.g. api://lims/Signature.Write. Empty = no access tokens.

data.name: Lock_Autostart_Service
data.value: The Vitrine service starts Vitrine in every session and supervises it. A start per user is not needed.

data.name: Entra_Broker_NotIncluded
data.value: Not included in this build (built without the Windows account broker). Vitrine signs in in its own sign-in window.

data.name: Shutdown_Reason
data.value: Vitrine: too many failed sign-in attempts

data.name: Event_SessionEndRefused
data.value: Sign-out or restart refused while locked

data.name: Lock_ShutdownBlockReason
data.value: The workstation is locked with Vitrine.

data.name: Audit_ModeServiceTitle
data.value: Written and signed by the service

data.name: Audit_ModeServiceText
data.value: The service ICT-Baden Vitrine writes the audit log and signs every entry; users can only read the log folder. It checks the sign-in of electronic signatures itself (Windows password, Microsoft Entra ID). Key fingerprint: {0}

data.name: Audit_ModeOfflineText
data.value: Entries are kept in memory and sent when the service is back ({0} waiting). Electronic signatures are not possible until then (VIT-0300).

data.name: Audit_ModeLocalText
data.value: Vitrine writes the audit log itself, without the service (single Vitrine.exe or installation with SERVICE=0). The entries are not signed: anyone who can write the log folder can add or change entries unnoticed. For a protected audit trail, install the MSI with the service.

data.name: AuditKey_Fingerprint
data.value: Key of the audit log on this computer (SHA-256 fingerprint): {0}

data.name: AuditKey_Exported
AuditKey_Rotated
data.value: New key of the audit log created; the change is recorded in the log, signed with the previous key. New fingerprint (SHA-256): {0}

data.value: Audit log now written and signed by the service

data.name: Event_AuditKeyRotated
data.value: Key of the audit log changed

data.name: Event_AuditLocalMode

data.name: Prompt_ExternalWindowsLogon
data.value: Windows opens its sign-in dialog. Sign in with your account – password, PIN or smart card.

data.name: Prompt_WindowsLogonMessage
data.value: Sign in with your own account.

data.name: Unlock_WindowsLogon_Desc
data.value: Windows security dialog: password, PIN or smart card (no FIDO2 security keys – use Microsoft for those) – for any account Windows accepts, also people who never signed in here.

data.name: SignIn_Hint
data.value: Sign-in window of Vitrine. Nothing is saved on this device – everything is deleted after the sign-in.

data.name: Entra_SignInHosts_Desc
data.value: Further sign-in pages for the Microsoft sign-in window, e.g. your federation service (adfs.contoso.com, *.okta.com). One per line. Microsoft's sign-in pages are always allowed.

data.name: Roles_Section
data.value: Who may do what in Vitrine

data.name: Roles_ConfigAdmins_Desc
data.value: May open and change the settings and exit Vitrine. One group per line (like the unlock groups). Empty = administrators only.

data.name: Roles_Registrars_Desc
data.value: May register and revoke security keys for other persons. Empty = administrators only.

data.name: Roles_Auditors_Desc
data.value: May view and export the audit log and the authorization report, but cannot change anything. Configuration administrators are always auditors too.

data.name: Roles_AdminsPrivileged_Desc
data.value: Off: members of the local Administrators group get no rights in Vitrine (settings, exit, key registration, emergency sign-in) unless they are in a role group. An administrator can still stop the service or edit the configuration file – this separates duties in Vitrine, not on the computer.

data.name: Roles_BypassGroups_Desc
data.value: Members may unlock with their Windows password even if the unlock rules do not allow them – only with a reason, which is recorded in the audit log and as a warning in the Windows event log. Empty = no emergency sign-in.

data.name: Roles_BypassMinLength
data.value: Minimum length of the emergency reason

data.name: Roles_ReasonAdmin_Desc
data.value: Opening the settings or exiting after a confirmation requires a reason; it is recorded in the audit log.

data.name: Roles_ReasonConfig_Desc
data.value: Saving the settings requires a reason. The audit log always records which values changed (old → new, secrets hidden).

data.name: Prompt_EmergencyNote
data.value: Emergency sign-in with your Windows password. Your reason is recorded in the audit log and reported.

data.name: Audit_Report_Tip
data.value: Who may unlock, use emergency sign-in and hold which role – as HTML for approval and as CSV

data.name: Error_VIT0435
data.value: The authorization report could not be written: {0}

data.name: Reason_Intro
data.value: {0} value(s) will change. The changes and your reason are recorded in the audit log.

data.name: Lock_Mode_Desc
data.value: Overlay: programs stay visible behind the lock. Separate desktop: Vitrine switches to its own desktop – other windows cannot receive input or draw over it; programs keep running hidden. Windows Hello and Microsoft sign-in briefly return to the Windows desktop.

data.name: Lock_DesktopPreview_Desc
data.value: With a separate desktop: shows a picture of the running programs (read-only, refreshed regularly). Follows the visual mode: nothing when covered, only the selected programs, covered areas stay covered.

data.name: Desktop_NoPreview
data.value: Programs keep running on the Windows desktop

data.name: Prompt_ExternalFido
data.value: Windows asks for your security key registered for Vitrine: insert it or hold it to the reader, enter its PIN and touch it.

data.name: Unlock_Fido_Desc
data.value: FIDO2 security keys registered for Vitrine (page Security keys), checked by the Vitrine service – no Entra app, also offline, the desktop stays visible. The PIN of the key is always required.

data.name: Keys_RpId_Desc
data.value: Identifier the keys are registered for. Do not change it after the first registration – keys only work with the RP ID they were registered with.

data.name: Keys_SelfRegistration_Desc
data.value: Off: a key is always registered by another authorized person (four-eyes principle).

data.name: Keys_MaxKeys_Desc
data.value: Maximum number of active keys per person.

data.name: Keys_MaxFailed_Desc
data.value: Refused sign-ins per key and per person before they are blocked for a while. 0 = never.

data.name: Keys_OfflineHours_Desc
data.value: Without a domain controller, the groups read last are used for at most this long. 0 = never sign in offline.

data.name: Keys_Models_Desc
data.value: AAGUIDs of the allowed key models, one per line. Empty = every model.

data.name: Keys_MethodOff
data.value: The method is switched off – switch on Security key under Unlocking to use the keys.

data.name: Keys_RegisterHint
data.value: First sign in yourself as an authorized person; then the person holds their key ready – Windows asks for its PIN (or to set one) and a touch.

data.name: Keys_RevokeHint
data.value: Key "{0}" of {1} will no longer unlock or sign. This cannot be undone.

data.name: Keys_StoreLocal
data.value: Keys are stored on this computer.

data.name: Keys_StoreDirectory
data.value: Keys are stored in Active Directory ({0}) · last synchronized {1}. Last use is shown for this computer.

data.name: Keys_DirectoryLoginHint
data.value: The security keys are stored in Active Directory. Vitrine writes the change there with your account. Your password is used only for this change and is not stored.

data.name: Keys_Store_Desc
data.value: Where registered keys are kept. Active Directory: a key registered once works on every computer of the domain. Takes effect after the Vitrine service restarts.

data.name: Keys_StoreDirectoryOption
data.value: Active Directory (all computers of the domain)

data.name: Keys_Container_Desc
data.value: Distinguished name of the Vitrine container. Empty = CN=Vitrine,CN=Program Data in the computer's domain.

data.name: Keys_SyncMinutes_Desc
data.value: How often the service reads all keys from Active Directory. A key presented at sign-in is checked live when Active Directory is reachable.
